notes: P03 baseline conformance test suite for SACMAT 2027 (PolicyTrace: Temporal Conformance Testing of Delegated Consent across Heterogeneous Policy Engines). tests/venue2027/sacmat/test_baseline_fidelity.py imports the REAL baseline module evaluation.venue2027.sacmat.baselines (no re-implementation, no stubs) and drives run_baseline through its public dispatch for EACH task-contract arm (B0 static policy diff, B1 single-engine testing, B2 multi-engine differential, B3 candidate temporal conformance) over SYNTHETIC (policy history, request) units in monotonic logical time (no PHI/PII, no network, no live provider, no hidden clock or randomness). Per arm: ONE POSITIVE vector (conformant delegated-consent case — a grant in force at the request's decision time — where every arm returns the correct conformance decision ADMIT/NO_DIVERGENCE) and ONE ADVERSARIAL NEGATIVE vector (expiry/skew divergence). The fidelity evidence is the CONTRAST on the adversarial case: the history-healed version-skew divergence (grant -> revoke -> regrant in force, POLICY_VERSION_BUMP after the request's decision time) where all three in-process engine models agree pointwise on PERMIT is REJECTed by B3 (B3_TEMPORAL_CONFORMANCE_DIVERGENCE / B3_POLICY_VERSION_SKEW_DIVERGENCE) and ADMItted — missed — by B0, B1 AND B2, asserted per-arm against the same case; the pure expiry race (grant lapsed at decision time, bump after it, oracle DENY) is additionally missed by B0/B1 and detected by B3. Expectations are adjudicated by the module's independent four-valued oracle oracle_decision (ordered-history state, never an engine model), asserted in tests so the expected conformance decisions are anchored outside the code under test; each weaker arm's miss is a recorded scientific result carrying its own reason-code path, not an error and not a stub. Unavailable upstream binaries (pinned Cedar v4.14.1, OpenFGA v1.22.1, OPA v1.22.4 belong to downstream SACMAT-X03/X04/X05): with the injected SacmatContext(simulate_unavailable_upstream=True) flag the engine-replay arms B1/B2/B3 return the transparent first-class outcome NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL / BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE (counted_as_success=False, retriable — never a toy substitution, never silently dropped), while B0 (pure in-process structural diff) still runs. Determinism: identical inputs give identical outcomes for every arm on both vector classes. Machine-checked: 23 new tests pass (positive vectors x4 arms, oracle-independence anchors, adversarial misses x3 weaker arms on the skew divergence + x2 on the expiry race, complete four-arm contrast, NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL battery, B0-runs-without-upstreams, determinism x4 arms); python3 -m pytest -q tests/venue2027/sacmat/test_baseline_fidelity.py exit 0; uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check on the three new files exit 0; full evaluation/venue2027 regression suite 1261 passed, exit 0. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work).
